declared.title: Randomized trial of a single-session digital intervention targeting emotion-related beliefs and emotion regulation
declared.foundIn: agent contre-preuve, recherche Crossref / Europe PMC du 2026-11-22 (reports/feeling-bad-about-feeling-bad/counter-evidence.md) ; titre relevé sur Crossref par l'agent : contrôle d'identité plus faible

findings.text: A short program teaching people to accept their negative emotions did not lower their distress more than relaxing videos

support.sentence: There was not a significant difference in changes in emotional distress between treatment conditions (d=0.13, p>.05).

limits: a single session, several ingredients mixed
an effect on distress only in the most distressed subgroup (secondary analysis)
